scope: Separate descriptive/source-inspection addendum; no frozen code, CI settings, primary outputs or prior reviews changed

confirmed_code_behavior.HBE_null_covariance: Cov = res.T @ res / n, with res formed from same-row products of centered Fourier features; HBE uses its positive eigenvalues.
confirmed_code_behavior.native_permutation_tail: Line300 computes p = proportion(permuted_stat > observed_stat), excluding tied statistics and without a Monte Carlo plus-one correction. This branch was not run or substituted into the pilot.

mechanistic_inference_not_established: With very sparse counts, absence of rare joint detections may distort the plug-in covariance estimate and the asymptotic HBE tail. This source inspection motivates that mechanism; it does not isolate or prove it experimentally.
future_design_constraint: A future discrete-count permutation procedure must address tied statistics and finite-Monte-Carlo correction explicitly. Changing approx to the installed perm branch alone is not a verified calibration remedy. No CI code was changed.
